title: Auditory-Feedback-Conditioned Flow TTS for Implicit Lombard Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) systems can lose intelligibility in noise environments because they cannot adapt to environmental changes. However, humans tend to increase their vocal efforts in noisy environments, a phenomenon known as the Lombard effect. Building on an auditory-feedback Lombard TTS, we investigate whether a pretrained Flow-based TTS can learn acoustic adaptation directly from auditory feedback without explicit prosodic control. Signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) feedback and automatic speech recognition (ASR) feedback are extracted from the noise-corrupted waveforms and injected into the Flow-matching condition for utterance refinement and causal block-level updates. We assess feedback benefits across prompting and noise conditions using plain/Lombard prompting, prompt-switching controls, and paired-finetuning. translated_title: 听觉反馈条件化的流式TTS实现隐式隆巴德效应适应
translated_abstract: 传统文本转语音（TTS）系统在噪声环境中可能会损失可懂度，因为它们无法适应环境变化。然而，人类在嘈杂环境中往往会增加发声力度，这一现象被称为隆巴德效应。基于听觉反馈的隆巴德TTS，我们研究预训练的基于流的TTS能否直接从听觉反馈中学习声学适应，而无需显式的韵律控制。信噪比（SNR）反馈和自动语音识别（ASR）反馈从被噪声污染的波形中提取，并注入到流匹配条件中，用于话语的精细化调整和因果块级更新。我们通过普通/隆巴德提示、提示切换对照和配对微调，评估了反馈在各种提示和噪声条件下的益处。实验表明，虽然微调在域内条件下提供了强大的鲁棒性，但听觉反馈（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将信噪比和语音识别反馈从噪声污染的音频中提取并注入流匹配TTS模型，使系统能像人类的隆巴德效应一样，无需显式韵律控制即可通过听觉反馈隐式适应噪声环境，提升噪声下的语音可懂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes injecting SNR and ASR feedback extracted from noise-corrupted audio into a Flow-matching TTS model, enabling the system to implicitly adapt to noisy environments through auditory feedback—mimicking the human Lombard effect—without explicit prosodic control, thereby improving speech intelligibility under noise.
